findings.issue: The module docstring asserts `This advances Layer 4, "Cartier duality", of the ReductiveGroups roadmap`, but Layer 4 is titled "Jordan decomposition, diagonalizable groups, tori" and has no target named "Cartier duality"; the roadmap mentions Cartier duality only in a parenthetical that defers it as a separate development.

summary: Documentation is otherwise complete and accurate: module docstring, main-declarations list, and per-declaration docstrings for all public API, none describing proofs. One docstring claim is factually wrong — the quoted ReductiveGroups Layer 4 target name does not exist in the roadmap.
